this is a corpus-assembly report: it contains no learning result, no generalisation claim and no ability claim
'chosen' is a 1-of-18 verified target (T02d's verify_k=1), not a full teacher ranking: 17 of the 18 scores per slot carry the unverified discount
the executed target and the verified teacher target are different labels and must be named separately by any consumer (G420-1); targets.jsonl exists so they cannot be conflated by accident
the 24 cold-start boundaries (decision frames 0..14 of three shards) stay excluded: nothing is padded and no candidate is invented
obs planes are T02c's own .npy files (link/copy/reference by configuration); this module never re-encodes a pixel
the per-slot HASH chain proves the label rows describe the same replayed trajectory; it does not re-measure the engine
a dataset that can be trained is not a trained policy: the trainability leg is one forward pass, one explicit CE and one 256-slot overfit, reported in evidence/T04/DATASET_2F.md

trainability.claim: one forward pass and one explicit cross-entropy per target prove the joined corpus is a valid model input with a usable label; the 256-slot 300-step overfit proves the data can be optimised. NEITHER is a generalisation, ability or gate result, and neither is G420-2.
not_claimed: no held-out split: the 256 rows are the training rows themselves
no dev/confirm seed is read (seeds 10/11/12 are train seeds)
no learning-rate or step-count sweep: the protocol is fixed in this file
no capability statement of any kind

protocol.selection: stride spread over the three shards, proportional to length
protocol.forward: one model(...) call in eval mode, then two cross_entropy calls

l1.question: does a corpus exist in which every two-frame slot has its own observation, HUD, executed action, eight real history decisions and a per-slot verified teacher label, with zero HASH diff?
l1.verdict: the L1 *data premise* holds: the corpus exists, every one of its 19,772 slots carries its own observation/HUD/executed action/eight history decisions and a per-slot verified teacher label, and every self-check is zero. L1 itself stays open: it asks that the corpus be *consumed*, i.e. enter a training run, which is T04's main body.
l1.not_a_gate_result: this file measures no learning, no generalisation and no ability; G420-0 is not passed by it and G420-2 is not started
